extracted.intended_audience: researchers and senior/key personnel preparing NIH-style biographical sketches for grant applications
extracted.subtask_description: Preparing an NIH-format Biographical Sketch for senior/key personnel and other significant contributors, following the specified section headers, formatting, and page limits for grant applications.

rubrics_metrics.name: Biographical Sketch — Format and Page Limit
rubrics_metrics.description: Provide the following information for the Senior/key personnel and other significant contributors. Follow this format for each person. DO NOT EXCEED FIVE PAGES.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This is the official biosketch format (OMB No. 0925-0001 and 0925-0002 Rev. 10/15). Ensure each person uses this format and keeps the biosketch to a maximum of five pages. Include the OMB/rev/approval header as appropriate.

rubrics_metrics.name: Required Header Fields
rubrics_metrics.description: NAME; eRA COMMONS USER NAME (agency login); POSITION TITLE
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Include these header fields exactly for each senior/key personnel or significant contributor. Use the agency-credential for the eRA Commons user name where applicable.

rubrics_metrics.name: Education/Training
rubrics_metrics.description: EDUCATION/TRAINING (Begin with baccalaureate or other initial professional education, such as nursing, include postdoctoral training and residency training if applicable.)
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Present as a table with columns: INSTITUTION AND LOCATION; DEGREE (if applicable); Completion Date MM/YYYY; FIELD OF STUDY. Add or delete rows as necessary. Start with initial professional education and include postdoc/residency when applicable.

rubrics_metrics.name: A. Personal Statement
rubrics_metrics.description: Personal Statement summarizing the objective of the proposed work, the individual's role in the project, relevant expertise, and mentoring/collaboration contributions.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: State how the applicant will contribute to the project (skills, techniques, mentorship). Include evidence of relevant expertise, prior relevant work, mentoring record, and any unique qualifications (e.g., specific technical skills, software familiarity). Use concise, focused language as shown in the example personal statements.

rubrics_metrics.name: B. Positions and Honors
rubrics_metrics.description: Positions and Employment; Other Experience and Professional Memberships; Honors.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: List positions with date ranges and titles (e.g., 1988 - 1997 Assistant Professor, ...). Include professional memberships and honors. Use chronological ranges and be specific about roles and institutions.

rubrics_metrics.name: C. Contribution to Science
rubrics_metrics.description: Provide numbered narrative entries describing key contributions to science, each accompanied by representative publications.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: For each numbered contribution, summarize the contribution's context, importance, and impact, then list representative publications (a., b., c., ...). Use this section to highlight major scientific achievements relevant to the proposed work.

rubrics_metrics.name: D. Research Support
rubrics_metrics.description: List Ongoing Research Support and Completed Research Support with grant numbers, dates, PI names, funding agency, project title and a brief description of goals/role.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Separate ongoing and completed support. For each entry include the grant number, PI (with role indicated, e.g., PI, Co-Investigator, Site PI), funding agency, project title, project dates, and a short statement of the project's goal and the individual's role (e.g., Role: PI). Follow examples shown (e.g., 'R01HD85233-01 Mahajan P (PI) Ruddy RM (site PI) 8/21/2015-5/30/2020 NICHD RNA Biosignatures...').

rubrics_metrics.name: Complete Bibliography Link
rubrics_metrics.description: Complete List of Published Work in My Bibliography: [URL]
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Optionally include a URL to the full bibliography (e.g., My NCBI bibliography link) to direct reviewers to a complete list of publications. This complements the representative citations listed in Contribution to Science.
